findings.issue: For a standard-plan nonprofit invoice of 0.01-0.04, APR-B01's 10% rounds to 0.00. The change prints these invoices in the undiscounted format (Commands.fs `if discount > 0m`), and the additional acceptance test pins that choice (`i3 issued to c2: 0.04 due ...`). The implementer says the sources leave this open (DEC-W-9) but implemented one answer anyway. The amount charged is the same either way, so no business rule is invented and this is not blocking. Still, the test fixes an output format that Finance has not confirmed.
findings.authorizedAlternative: APR-B01 sets the amount (entered amount minus a 0.00 discount, which leaves it unchanged), and BILL-13-R1 says an invoice without a discount prints as before. Keep the question open for Finance, as already recorded in docs/notes/2026-10-22-bill-13-questions-for-finance.md, and treat the 0.04 test assertion as provisional until Finance answers.
